_about: Pre-registered per-case predictions for the capstone-subobject arm (-Xclang -fcapstone-subobject-bounds, C1 v1: non-last ARRAY fields only; refuses trailing arrays, unions, flexible arrays). Committed before the run.

_why.00: num_nalus_in_du_minus1[] is a NON-LAST array field: v1 narrows it, index SEGMENTS leaves it
_why.01: RefPicSetStCurrBefore[] is a non-last array field
_why.02: ref_src[] is a non-last array field
_why.03: last[] is a non-last array field (cur[] follows)
_why.04: control_url[] is the struct's LAST member: v1 refuses trailing arrays (the flexible-array idiom), so it is not narrowed
_why.05: tile_sizes[] is a non-last array field
_why.06: entry_point_start_ctu[] is the LAST member of the nested struct sh: refused as a trailing array
_why.07: key_uri[] is a non-last array field; the pointer is narrowed where it is passed to av_strlcpy, so the fault lands INSIDE the strlcpy, not at a labelled probe
_why.08: col_width_val[] is a non-last array field
_why.09: the slices are pointer arithmetic inside ONE int array, not struct fields: nothing for field bounds to narrow
